## AquaNuchar is a wood-based activated carbon with an almost 100-year history of use in water purification. Because of its structure, purity and renewable nature, wood is a superior carbon source for municipal water treatment needs. This means that customers have a reliable solution when they need to control purification, taste and odor challenges quickly and effectively. That’s The Ingevity Effect.


---


### **Customer:** Orange Water and Sewer Authority, Carrboro, N.C.
**Product:** AquaNuchar® chemically-activated powdered carbon
**End-use application:** Municipal water treatment


---


### **Problem**


Total organic carbon (TOC) naturally occurs in untreated water and must be purified by drinking water treatment processes in order to make the water suitable for drinking as determined by the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA). Naturally-occurring TOC levels are the main precursor for EPA-regulated byproducts that form during the water disinfection process. Utility providers like the award-winning[Orange Water and Sewer Authority](https://www.owasa.org/) (OWASA) in Carrboro, N.C., are no stranger to such purification and treatment challenges.


“Not only does[AquaNuchar](https://www.ingevity.com/featured-products/aquanuchar/) provide the adsorption needed to remove TOC in the water treatment process, its unique adsorptive capacity also enables water utilities to dose less[AquaNuchar](https://www.ingevity.com/featured-products/aquanuchar/) than would be required with other carbons,” explained Tim Byrne, senior applications engineer at Ingevity. “Ingevity helps water utilities meet and exceed the EPA’s TOC removal requirements, save money, and ultimately keep their customers happy.”


### **Solution**


The effectiveness of[AquaNuchar](https://www.ingevity.com/featured-products/aquanuchar/) wood-based, powdered activated carbon compared to coal-based alternatives has been known to municipalities across the U.S., especially OWASA. OWASA has a strong history of providing high quality water, testing their drinking water more than 40,000 times each year to ensure its quality and compliance with federal and state drinking standards. The actual carbon performance in OWASA’s process exceeds TOC removal as predicted by lab-scale jar testing, made possible with the addition of AquaNuchar.


### **Maximizing value**


- The large surface area and extensive pore structure of[AquaNuchar](https://www.ingevity.com/featured-products/aquanuchar/) carbon enables the adsorption of algal toxins and other dissolved organic compounds.
- [AquaNuchar](https://www.ingevity.com/featured-products/aquanuchar/) ’s higher pore volume and surface area mean treated water has greater purity in a shorter amount of time while using less carbon.
- [AquaNuchar](https://www.ingevity.com/featured-products/aquanuchar/) can potentially offset the capital-intensive installation of granular carbon beds.
